data.title: Global deforestation slowed in 2025 but surged in Congo basin: study
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Deforestation slowed worldwide last year, but the improvement is unlikely to last as the situation deteriorates in Central Africa and an exceptionally strong El Nino weather pattern intensifies, a new study said on Wednesday.

data.title: Microsoft's Brad Smith calls for 'real and effective' AI safety standards
data.description: DUBLIN - Microsoft president Brad Smith warned Tuesday that industry and governments must "act with urgency" to create "real and effective safety standards" to contain the risks linked to artificial intelligence.

data.title: Regulator 'will resign' if any political interference in Man City case
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - The chair of English football's Independent Regulator has said he will resign if there is political interference in any future investigation into Manchester City as a result of widespread impropriety.

data.title: US fines Bank of America $1.2 bn for anti-money laundering violations
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The US Treasury Department said Tuesday that it is imposing penalties of more than $1.2 billion on Bank of America, citing "violations of anti-money laundering and sanctions laws."

data.title: Trump, White House post video of UK man killed by tiger
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump posted disturbing footage on his Truth Social account Tuesday of a man being fatally mauled by a tiger in Britain, sparking backlash on social media.

data.title: Pat Bradley: A lovely swing to remember
data.description: The swing that God gave Pat Bradley was a thing of beauty. It was a lovely rhythmic motion that never seemed to change, whatever club she was using. I found her practising at the Florida club she called home at the time. After a while, she spotted me watching her go through her practice routine and said hello, she caught my English accent and asked me many questions. I had always wanted to meet her as I had admired her swing ever since I saw it on TV.

data.title: Bangkok condos squeezed by floods, weak demand and 65,300-unit glut
data.description: Bangkok’s condo market faces weak purchasing power, flooding and more than 65,300 unsold units worth THB370 billion.

data.title: Atletico sink Man Utd as Viking deny Bayern in Champions League
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Atletico Madrid beat Manchester United 2-0 in the UEFA Champions League on Tuesday as the Red Devils continued their poor run, while Bayern Munich were held 3-3 in Norway by underdogs Viking Stavanger.

data.title: Young Om gives Thailand Olympic boost
data.description: Putthaphum Nakpaen has emerged as the best U23 BMX racer in Asia after a breakthrough World Cup campaign in China, giving Thailand a significant boost in its bid to qualify for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

data.title: Rangsan's Chonburi stint ends after 4 losses in row
data.description: Chonburi have parted company with head coach Rangsan Viwatchaichok and his assistant, Sinthaweechai Hathairattanakool, after a winless run of four Thai League 1 games this season.

data.title: Easy win for mixed duo as Ratchanok pulls out injured
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran advanced to the second round of the US$950,000 Denmark Open in Odense on Tuesday.

data.title: Scam crackdowns net 39 suspects
data.description: Police arrested 39 suspects and seized assets worth more than 500 million baht in raids across 11 provinces targeting a transnational scam and money-laundering network.

data.title: Unsit rejects 'shame' jibe over exams
data.description: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat on Tuesday defended the ministry's handling of alleged fraud in local recruitment exams, hitting back at criticism from his predecessor.

data.title: Raid frees exploited Myanmar children
data.description: Authorities have arrested four suspects and rescued children from Myanmar allegedly forced to sell flowers and other goods to tourists in Bangkok.
